# security-openbao-follow-namespace

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> OpenBao in a namespace other than `security` — not a Component: a transformer.
>
> An overlay's `namespace:` moves every namespaced resource of security/openbao and its
> sub-components (api_addr and cluster_addr follow on their own: the pod builds them
> from its namespace). Two references to the namespace are values, not metadata, and
> `namespace:` does not touch them:
> - the subject of ClusterRoleBinding openbao-auth-delegator (kubernetes auth breaks
> without it: OpenBao cannot call TokenReview)
> - spec.provider.vault.server of ClusterSecretStore openbao (eso-store)
> This transformer copies the namespace of ServiceAccount openbao into both.
>
> Usage — in the SAME kustomization that sets `namespace:`:
> namespace: my-namespace
> resources:
> - path/to/security/openbao
> components:
> - path/to/security/openbao/eso-store        # optional, also followed
> transformers:
> - path/to/security/openbao/follow-namespace
>
> Why not a Component: a Component runs before the consuming kustomization's own
> `namespace:`, so it would still read `security`. A transformer listed under
> `transformers:` runs after it. An overlay further up that changes the namespace again
> needs this line too. Without `namespace:` it changes nothing (everything stays in
> `security`).

## Notes

A `ReplacementTransformer`, referenced under `transformers:` (not `components:`)
in the overlay that sets `namespace:`. It copies the namespace of ServiceAccount
`openbao` into the subject of ClusterRoleBinding `openbao-auth-delegator` and into
the host of the ClusterSecretStore `server:`, two values `namespace:` does not touch.

It cannot be a Component: Components run before their consumer's own
`namespace:`, so it would still read `security` (verified by build). An overlay
further up that changes the namespace again needs the line too. Without
`namespace:` it is a no-op.
